Hi Ben! Sorry for the stress. Here's what I can tell you for NW2003 (Standard, to Valencia, promised by 18 Nov):

- Delivery windows run from 8:00 to 20:00 local time. So the courier can't come after 8 in the evening (20:00) on her birthday. Our policy has no option for a later slot or a specific delivery time.
- NW2003 is promised by 18 Nov, so it should arrive before her birthday on the 20th. Standard takes 3–5 business days.

On your depot parcel (NW2001): it's held at the depot for 5 business days after the failed attempt on 7 Nov. You can book one free redelivery. After 5 business days it goes back to the sender, so please book soon.

I can't promise any special service upgrades, as I can only go by our delivery policy.
